from typing import Literal, Optional, List
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCauseMapping(BaseModel):
    """Captures the mapping of a single document's title to its legal cause category."""
    document_title: Optional[str] = Field(description="The title of the document, e.g., '《判决文书 1》'")
    cause_category: Literal[
        '执行案由 - 先予执行',
        '执行案由 - 行政非诉执行',
        '物权保护纠纷',
        '执行案由 - 对下级法院执行异议裁定的复议',
        '行政行为 - 行政许可',
        '继承纠纷',
        '行政行为 - 行政征收',
        '适用特殊程序案件案由',
        '知识产权与竞争纠纷',
        '行政主体 - 行政检查（监察）'
    ] = Field(description="The specific legal cause category this document belongs to")
    reason_quote: Optional[str] = Field(description="Short text excerpt justifying the cause classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    document_mappings: List[DocumentCauseMapping] = Field(description="List of all document-to-cause mappings found across the processed documents")
